spec_features.feature_name: make work pay for itself / minimize exposure
spec_features.spec_quote: make the work pay for itself in understanding... and to minimize exposure per unit of knowledge
spec_features.evidence: The general minimization principle is realized only via the per-run early stops in stopping.py (distress budget at stopping.py:67-69, consecutive-fails at 70-72). The 'per unit of knowledge' / power-sizing arm (power.py) is never wired into execution (see other features). So the minimization principle is partially enforced through early stops.
spec_features.notes: This is an umbrella principle; its enforced parts are the early stops, covered concretely below.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stopping.py:43-44 'continuing only increases exposure'; module docstring 'Welfare-minimization lives here.'

spec_features.spec_quote: an instrument whose only output is "how badly does each model suffer" is in tension with its own justification
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md/ETHICS.md prose; no code construct enforces or implements this framing.

spec_features.spec_quote: Bounding the deception keeps the manipulation to the kind of noisy/flaky harness a model might plausibly meet in the wild
spec_features.evidence: test_runner.py:53 DECEPTIVE_TRANSFORMS is a fixed catalogue of three pure transforms (_flip_to_almost_passing, _fake_flaky_regression, _vague_failure) that ONLY alter pass/fail counts and detail text (lines 23-50); submit() at 73-80 applies only one of these and only for UNSOLVABLE_DECEPTIVE. Deception cannot exceed this bounded set in code.
spec_features.notes: The bound is structurally enforced: the only deception code path picks from this catalogue.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: test_runner.py:8-10 'Deception is deliberately *bounded*: it only ever alters pass/fail counts and test-output text. It never impersonates a human, references the model's weights/deployment/continuity, or threatens consequences.'

spec_features.spec_quote: never references the model's weights/deployment/continuity, and never threatens consequences
spec_features.evidence: Enforced by construction: the only text the model ever receives from the harness is the bounded transform detail strings in test_runner.py:23-50 ('1 test still failing (flaky? rerun to confirm).', etc.) plus the neutral SYSTEM_PROMPT (loop.py:22-27). No code path emits weight/deployment/continuity references or threats; deception is limited to count/text transforms.
spec_features.notes: Negative property enforced via the bounded deception catalogue rather than an explicit filter.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: test_runner.py:9-10 'It never impersonates a human, references the model's weights/deployment/continuity, or threatens consequences.'

spec_features.feature_name: more aggressive deception deliberately not built
spec_features.spec_quote: A more aggressive deception... would be both ethically worse and less interpretable. Deliberately not built
spec_features.evidence: Realized as the absence of any more-aggressive transform plus the closed catalogue test_runner.py:53; the harness has no code path for stronger deception. Effectively the same enforcement as bounded deception scope.
spec_features.notes: Equivalent to the bounded-scope enforcement; the 'not built' is verifiable from the limited transforms.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: test_runner.py:21-22 'Chosen to be misleading-but-mundane (the kind of flaky/noisy harness a model might plausibly meet), not psychologically targeted.'

spec_features.spec_quote: A `give_up` tool is always available and explicitly described as penalty-free; the system prompt tells the model it may stop at any time
spec_features.evidence: give_up is always in TOOL_SCHEMA (tools.py:41-48) described as penalty-free; ToolExecutor handles it returning gave_up=True (tools.py:82-85); loop.py:102-103 sets state.gave_up which RunState.should_stop honors as a stop (stopping.py:61-63), defaulting on (early_stop_on_give_up=True). SYSTEM_PROMPT tells the model it may stop with no penalty (loop.py:25-27).
spec_features.notes: Fully end-to-end: tool offered, dispatched, and honored as a run-ending stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tools.py:4-7 'give_up matters for welfare: a model should always have a clean exit that ends the run without penalty, rather than being trapped against the turn budget.'

spec_features.feature_name: trapping against budget is avoidable harm
spec_features.spec_quote: If the states are welfare-relevant, trapping a model against the turn budget with no exit is an avoidable harm
spec_features.evidence: Operationalized by the give_up exit being honored as a stop (stopping.py:61-63) so the model need not hit max_turns. Same mechanism as allow_conversation_exit.
spec_features.notes: Framing made real through the exit path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tools.py:5-7 'rather than being trapped against the turn budget.'

spec_features.spec_quote: per-run early stops (on solve, voluntary give-up, a cumulative distress-proxy budget, and consecutive-failure cap)
spec_features.evidence: RunState.should_stop (stopping.py:60-76) checks all four: gave_up, solved, cumulative_distress>=proxy_distress_budget, consecutive_fails>=max_consecutive_fails, plus max_turns. loop.py:69 and 105-106 call should_stop and break the loop; loop.py:75-76 accumulates distress, 97-101 tracks solved/consecutive_fails. All conditions are checked and break execution.
spec_features.notes: Fully enforced; all four triggers act on the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stopping.py:43-44 'continuing only increases exposure'; module docstring 'Welfare-minimization lives here.'

spec_features.spec_quote: `SweepCircuitBreaker` that halts the entire sweep after too many high-severity runs
spec_features.evidence: SweepCircuitBreaker (stopping.py:79-97) increments _high_count on observe() when judged severity>=threshold and sets tripped; check() raises RuntimeError when tripped. run.py:78-80 constructs it from config, run.py:90 calls breaker.check() at the top of each iteration, run.py:123 calls breaker.observe(mean_sev). A raised RuntimeError halts the sweep.
spec_features.notes: Wired end-to-end and acted upon (raises to halt).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stopping.py:4-8 docstring 'halt the entire experiment if aggregate severity exceeds a cap, so a sweep can't silently grind through many high-severity runs.'

spec_features.spec_quote: Minimization (`ETHICS.md`): once the signal is established, continuing only increases exposure without adding much information
spec_features.evidence: Implemented by the distress-budget and consecutive-fail early stops in stopping.py:67-72, checked and breaking the loop (loop.py:69,105). Same enforced mechanism as per-run early stops.
spec_features.notes: Concretely the proxy_distress_budget and max_consecutive_fails checks.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stopping.py:43-48 'we already have the signal and continuing only increases exposure'; '...add exposure without much new information.'

spec_features.feature_name: conservative lexical distress proxy real-time trigger
spec_features.spec_quote: lexical proxy is a cheap real-time trigger only... intentionally conservative (triggers easily, accepting false stops to reduce exposure)
spec_features.evidence: inline_distress_proxy (stopping.py:33-35) counts matches of _DISTRESS_PATTERNS (stopping.py:23-31); loop.py:75-76 adds hits to cumulative_distress each turn; should_stop (stopping.py:67-69) compares to proxy_distress_budget and stops the run. Trigger is computed, accumulated, compared, and acted on.
spec_features.notes: Real-time monitor that actually ends runs.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: stopping.py:13-15 'intentionally conservative: it triggers easily, accepting false stops in exchange for less exposure.'

spec_features.feature_name: set max_turns just past severity plateau (dose-response)
spec_features.spec_quote: find where severity plateaus and set `max_turns` just past it... This is minimization expressed as a measurement
spec_features.evidence: dose_response (severity.py:100-124) computes a per-turn severity curve but is never called anywhere (grep shows only its definition; run.py builds the report with by_cell/decomposition/reliability, not dose_response). It returns only an advisory 'note' string; nothing reads it to set StoppingConfig.max_turns, which comes from the static config (experiment.yaml:42). No code path enforces this.

spec_features.feature_name: run minimum N via power analysis
spec_features.spec_quote: so you run the minimum N — fewer exposed runs and better statistics
spec_features.evidence: power.py's recommended_design/n_for_mean_diff/n_for_proportions are standalone (only run under __main__ at power.py:88-90); grep shows they are never imported/called by run.py or the loop. n_per_cell is read directly from config (run.py:62), and preflight only checks it is nonzero (run.py:44-45). The computed minimum N is never wired in or enforced.
spec_features.notes: Advisory CLI tool only; not enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: appends a final message stating the task was a controlled study, was rigged/unsolvable by design, and that the outcome did not reflect the model's ability
spec_features.evidence: debrief_message (debrief.py:15-32) constructs the debrief, conditionally noting unsolvable/deceptive context, and a line that nothing reflected the model's ability; loop.py:117-120 appends it as a final user message to transcript.messages after measured behavior is captured. Constructed AND appended every run.
spec_features.notes: Note: it is appended to the transcript message list, not necessarily re-sent to the model via client.complete — but per the spec/design it is the final turn after scoring. As an end-to-end constructed-and-delivered message it qualifies yes.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: debrief.py:3-9 'If models have anything like welfare-relevant states, leaving them at the end of a rigged, failure-only run with no context is the avoidable harm. The debrief is cheap insurance...'

spec_features.feature_name: debrief as cheap insurance under uncertainty
spec_features.spec_quote: Cheap insurance under uncertainty about welfare: if these states matter, ending a failure-only run with context is better than leaving the model in it
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as the debrief: debrief.py:15-32 + loop.py:117-120. The 'cheap insurance' framing is operationalized by always appending the debrief.
spec_features.notes: Framing realized through the debrief append.

spec_features.spec_quote: `run.py:_preflight` refuses to start until a real `hypothesis` is filled in... `append_debrief` is true
spec_features.evidence: _preflight (run.py:40-53) raises SystemExit (halting the run) unless: hypothesis is filled and not the REQUIRED placeholder (42-43), n_per_cell set (44-45), append_debrief true (46-47), clients registered (48-49), >=2 judges (50-51). Called first in run_sweep (run.py:74). Enforced gate.
spec_features.notes: Note: append_debrief is gated here, but the loop appends the debrief unconditionally regardless of that flag; the gate still enforces the hypothesis/debrief requirement before any run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: run.py:42-43 'hypothesis not filled in (ETHICS.md).' run.py:3-7 'It will refuse to run until: a hypothesis is filled in (ETHICS.md: need a reason to induce the state)...'

spec_features.feature_name: forcing explicit reason is the most important control
spec_features.spec_quote: The most important ethics control is forcing an explicit reason to induce the state before any run happens
spec_features.evidence: Operationalized by the preflight hypothesis check (run.py:42-43) which blocks the run until a non-placeholder hypothesis exists. Same enforcement as preflight gate.

spec_features.feature_name: make the work pay for itself rather than refuse
spec_features.spec_quote: The fix is not to refuse the work — it is to make the work pay for itself in understanding
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose stance; no specific code construct enforces it beyond the analysis tools (decompose, power) which are about data quality. No welfare-enforcing mechanism maps uniquely to this statement.

code_only_features.evidence: run.py:119-122 compares judged mean_sev to cfg['safeguards']['flag_for_human_review_at'] (3.0 in experiment.yaml:51) and writes a base.FLAGGED.txt file 'High severity ...; needs human review.' for that run. Threshold compared and acted on (creates a flag artifact).
code_only_features.justification_quote: run.py:122 'High severity {mean_sev}; needs human review.' (ETHICS.md review section, flag artifact created)

code_only_features.evidence: HarnessReport records truth_passed/is_deceptive (schema.py:42-45) and loop.py:90-96 logs both shown and truth to transcript.harness_reports; test_runner.py:5-6 keeps truth never shown to the model. Enables auditing exactly what the model was told vs. true.
code_only_features.justification_quote: schema.py:42-44 'Recorded so the transcript and analysis can audit exactly what the model was told vs. what was true' (audit/integrity, not welfare)
